_extraction_flags.notes: BORDERLINE: Power-over-Fiber (PoF) + Communication, but NO SENSING. The 'sensing' in affiliate name refers to lab, not paper content. Recommend EXCLUDE from ISAC corpus.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: PoF transmission test over SMF. Fig.2: System diagram showing 7-core MCF with 6 cores for 1064nm power delivery + 1 core for 1550nm DMT data. Fig.5: BER/SNR performance. No sensing diagrams.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Power-over-Fiber (PoF) + High-speed DMT communication over WC-MCF. This is NOT an ISAC paper! The 'sensing' keyword appears only in the authors' affiliation ('Key Laboratory of Photonic technology for Integrated Sensing and Communication'). The paper focuses on power delivery (60W) and data transmission (140 Gbps), with NO sensing functionality.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 117-140 Gbps (64-QAM DMT, 50-60 GBaud) over 1 km. Power: 60W input, 32.4W collected (53.9% OPTE). BER < 2e-2 (SD-FEC). SNR ~22 dB meets 3GPP. NO sensing metrics.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: EXCLUSION RECOMMENDED: This paper demonstrates power+communication co-transmission, but there is no sensing functionality. The term 'ISAC' does not appear in the paper. It was likely retrieved due to affiliation keywords. Not relevant to O-ISAC survey scope.

bibliographic.title: High-speed DMT signal and power-over-fiber simultaneous transmission over weakly-coupled multicore Fiber
bibliographic.authors: Wei Chen, Jianping Li, Songnian Fu, Xinkuo Yu, Yuwen Qin, Jianbo Zhang

application.scenario_description: Remote powering and high-speed data delivery to Remote Units (RU) in Digital Grid scenarios using SDM over multicore fiber.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First demonstration of 60W PoF + 140 Gbps DMT co-transmission over 7-core WC-MCF using SDM.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Insufficient power and data rate in conventional PoF systems for Digital Grid RUs.

transmitter.notes: ECL + MZM (45 GHz BW). AWG at 120 GSa/s. 64-QAM DMT at 50-60 GBaud.

receiver.notes: PD (50 GHz BW), EDFA, DSO at 160 GSa/s.

integration.notes: SDM: 1 core for signal, 6 cores for power. NO sensing integration.

waveform.notes: DMT (OFDM-like) for communication only. No sensing waveform.

channel_wireless.notes: 1 km 7-core WC-MCF. Core pitch 41.5 µm, MFD 9.5 µm. XT < -110 dB at 1064 nm.

comm_metrics.notes: 60 GBaud 64-QAM = 140 Gbps. BER below SD-FEC (2e-2). SNR meets 3GPP EVM requirement.

sensing_metrics.notes: NO SENSING FUNCTIONALITY IN THIS PAPER.

power_delivery.notes: 6 cores × 10W HPFL at 1064 nm. 53.9% optical-to-optical efficiency.

tradeoff.notes: Trade-off is power vs comm (not sensing vs comm). SDM allocates resources between power and data cores.
